## v0.5.29: Git sync, Provider and Pack fixes / Git 同步、Provider 与记忆包修复

Publishes [#371](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/371), [#372](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/372), [#375](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/375)–[#382](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/382).

- Git sync no longer multiplies Memory Spaces (#370): spaces are compared by their memories, and two versions of a space merge into one. Project Document edits travel as edits instead of copies.
- Git sync handles Mnemon Packs past about 4.4 MB of base64 (#368) and GitHub sign-in answered form-encoded (#369). The Memory System shows what a sync or an import brought in, and a failed **Merge here only** says why.
- A Provider namespace created after its settings were saved reaches Memory Spaces (#373): the Host asks once after it starts, and **Rediscover** asks on demand. New spaces start inactive; mounted and disconnected ones stay as they are.
- OpenViking stores memories on 0.4.16 and keeps their category (#353), and leaves out a memory the server can no longer read instead of failing the space. Hindsight strips entity notes in linear time.

发布 [#371](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/371)、[#372](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/372)、[#375](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/375)–[#382](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/382)。

- Git 同步不再使记忆空间成倍增加（#370）：按记忆比较空间，同一空间的两个版本合并为一个；项目档案的编辑以编辑而非副本的形式传递。
- Git 同步能处理 base64 超过约 4.4 MB 的记忆包（#368）以及以表单编码回复的 GitHub 登录（#369）；记忆系统会直接显示同步或导入带来的内容，**仅合并到本机**失败时会说明原因。
- 设置保存之后新建的 Provider 命名空间会进入记忆空间（#373）：Host 启动后询问一次，**重新发现**可随时再问；新空间以未激活状态挂载，已挂载与断开过的空间保持原样。
- OpenViking 可在 0.4.16 上写入并保留分类（#353），并略过服务器已无法读取的记忆，不再让整个空间不可用；Hindsight 以线性时间去除实体注释。

The Starter advances to **0.5.29**, Memory Spaces to **0.5.19**, OpenViking to **0.5.8** and Hindsight to **0.5.6**. The other 14 component versions are unchanged. Existing memory needs no migration.

Starter 升至 **0.5.29**，记忆空间升至 **0.5.19**，OpenViking 升至 **0.5.8**，Hindsight 升至 **0.5.6**；其余 14 个组件版本不变，无需迁移已有记忆。

Use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH, or install the exact version:

使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.29
```

Independently maintained copies in the Profile also need `dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces@0.5.19`, `dsh-mnemon-provider-openviking@0.5.8` or `dsh-mnemon-provider-hindsight@0.5.6`.

Profile 独立维护的副本也需更新到 `dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces@0.5.19`、`dsh-mnemon-provider-openviking@0.5.8` 或 `dsh-mnemon-provider-hindsight@0.5.6`。
